title: The kth hash measures the unseen crowd
hook: Repeated observations need not provide new evidence of distinct items.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Uniform hash/draw assumptions; probability and weighted ranks as stated.
doesNotKnow: Estimate distinct count from the kth smallest distinct uniform hash and ignore repeat hashes.

misconception: Repeated observations must move a distinct-count sketch's estimate upward.
objective: Estimate distinct count from the kth smallest distinct uniform hash and ignore repeat hashes.

claims.text: Repeated hashes do not create new minima. This finite example uses supplied normalized values; the distinct-count estimate relies on approximately uniform hashing, and is an estimate rather than the exact number of distinct items.
